international.title: Belgian authorities order Google to halt datacentre construction over lack of permits
international.summary: Greenpeace had published report showing tech firm was carrying on building despite ruling on its planning appeal still unresolved Belgian authorities have ordered Google to halt construction work on a large datacentre in the south of the country because the US tech firm’s requests to modify the original terms of the planning permission did not have approval. “Inspectors visited the site and observed that the building was almost finished, with the structural work completed, even though the permit had been refused,” Raphaël Stokis, a Wallonia regional official, told the public broadcaster RTBF .
